title: Plugin keep-coding-instructions Frontmatter Field (v2.1.94)
description: New keep-coding-instructions frontmatter field for plugins that controls how Claude presents its output during an agentic coding session. Allows plugin authors to customize post-task behavior — e.g., whether to pause, summarize, or continue coding. Enables workflow-specific completion patterns embedded in plugins.

evaluation.reasoning: Official v2.1.94 feature. Corrected maintenance from 70 to 95 (Anthropic-maintained built-in, zero ongoing effort) and token_efficiency from 50 to 60 (suppressing post-task summaries provides minor savings in agentic loops). Integration path: add field to relevant SKILL.md frontmatter after confirming exact accepted values from v2.1.94 release notes. The field is particularly relevant for skills used in automated loops (iterative-improve, heartbeat) where summary output adds noise.
evaluation.integration_notes: Before integrating: (1) confirm exact accepted values for keep-coding-instructions (boolean? string enum?) from v2.1.94 changelog, (2) identify which of our SKILL.md files produce unwanted post-task summaries, (3) determine whether it applies to global skills (~/.claude/skills/) or only plugin-bundled skills. Priority skills to evaluate: iterative-improve, deploy-staging, plan-tracker.
